payload.question_text: Which steps are part of speech synthesis?

options.rationale: Synthesis begins by breaking text into individual words. This is tokenization.
Words receive phonetic sounds through phonetic transcription. This prepares them for spoken delivery.
Mapping phonemes back to words describes the recognition direction. Synthesis moves from supplied text toward audio.
options.better_fit: Use this when recognizing speech from sound representations.

options.rationale: Synthesis creates phonemes before synthesizing audio. These represent the speech sounds used for output.

payload.explanation: Correct. Synthesis moves from text through phonetic processing to audio.

options.rationale: This describes speech recognition, which begins with spoken input and produces written text. Text-to-speech works in the opposite direction.
options.better_fit: Use this when spoken words need to become a written transcript.

options.rationale: Mapping phonemes to words is associated with speech recognition. Synthesis starts with text and produces audio.
options.better_fit: This fits a recognition process that interprets speech sounds as words.

options.rationale: Text-to-speech creates spoken output from text-based data. Its result is audible speech.
Transcription converts recorded speech into text. Text-to-speech generates audio from written content.
options.better_fit: Use this for a voicemail or call that needs a written record.

payload.explanation: Correct. Text-to-speech converts written content into audible speech.

payload.question_text: Speech synthesis can organize phonetic transcription into prosodic units such as phrases, clauses, or sentences.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would skip the grouping that organizes speech before audio is produced.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Speech synthesis organizes phonetic transcription into prosodic units.

payload.explanation: Correct. Prosodic units can be phrases, clauses, or sentences.

payload.question_text: Speech synthesis generates spoken output from text-based data.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would incorrectly rule out the capability used to make written content audible.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Speech synthesis, also called text-to-speech, generates spoken output from text-based data.

payload.explanation: Correct. Speech synthesis creates audible speech from text-based data.

payload.question_text: A station is automating its public-address content. Which tasks can be performed with synthesized speech?

options.rationale: Transcription converts spoken calls into written text. It does not create an audible reply or announcement.
options.better_fit: Use this for customer-support calls that need written records.

options.rationale: Synthesized speech can generate audible replies to user input. It provides spoken output.

options.text: Identify the language in an audio recording
options.rationale: Language identification analyzes an existing audio recording. Synthesized speech generates new spoken audio.
options.better_fit: Use this when an application must classify the language being spoken.

options.rationale: Synthesized speech can create audio for public announcements. The resulting speech can be played to listeners.

payload.explanation: Correct. Synthesized speech can provide spoken replies and broadcast announcements.

payload.question_text: Which voice type uses neural networks for more natural sounding speech?

options.rationale: Neural voices use neural networks. They provide more natural speech and improved intonation.
Predefined voices support languages and regional pronunciation. The neural-network feature specifically identifies neural voices.
options.better_fit: Use this when selecting available voices with language and regional-pronunciation support.

options.rationale: Custom voices are developed for use with the API. They are not defined by the neural-network feature stated here.
options.better_fit: Use this when a voice has been developed for the Text-to-Speech API.

options.rationale: Acoustic models help speech recognition analyze audio. They are not Text-to-Speech voice types.
options.better_fit: Use this when discussing speech recognition processing.

payload.explanation: Correct. Neural voices use neural networks and can improve naturalness and intonation.

payload.question_text: Synthesized speech is used to convert customer calls into written transcripts.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would treat a written-record task as though it produced spoken output.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Synthesized speech generates audio; speech recognition converts calls into written transcripts.

payload.explanation: Correct. Customer-call transcripts use speech recognition.

payload.question_text: Which delivery settings can be adjusted in the Text-to-Speech Foundry playground?

options.rationale: Speed is an available delivery setting in the playground. It changes the pace of generated audio.

options.error_type: Confuses delivery controls with audio analysis
options.rationale: Speaker identification analyzes recorded conversation audio. It does not change synthesized delivery.
options.better_fit: Use this when an application must determine who spoke each segment.

options.rationale: Pitch is an available delivery setting in the playground. It changes perceived highness or lowness.
Audio transcription produces text from audio. It is not a setting for generated speech.
options.better_fit: Use this when recorded speech must become written text.

payload.explanation: Correct. The playground lets users adjust speed and pitch.

payload.question_text: Azure Speech Text-to-Speech offers predefined voices with language and regional-pronunciation support.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would overlook an available option for matching language and regional pronunciation.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: The API includes predefined voices with language and regional-pronunciation support.

payload.explanation: Correct. Predefined voices support multiple languages and regional pronunciation.

payload.question_text: The Text-to-Speech playground creates a written transcript from synthesized text.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: This would expect written notes when the result is meant for a listener.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: The Text-to-Speech playground generates audio from text; transcription produces written text.

payload.explanation: Correct. The Text-to-Speech playground generates audio output, not a written transcript.
